message:
Now let me look at the builtin_x86_defs to understand the CPU models and their cpuid values. Let me also look at the helper_cpuid function in misc_helper.c:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>grep -n "builtin_x86_defs" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/unicorn/qemu/target/i386/cpu.c | head -5 && echo "---" && sed -n '105,140p' /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/unicorn/qemu/target/i386/misc_helper.c</｜｜DSML｜｜>
